title.narrative: Promoting women economic empowerment through contributing to poor households access to, and control over their own incomeearning opportunities and socioeconomic services, including through social protection schemes such as the PSSN II.

description.narrative: This action is in line with the EU Action Document for Gender Transformation Action in Tanzania: Breaking the Glass Ceiling, specific objective 2, of promoting women economic empowerment through contributing to poor households access to, and control over their own incomeearning opportunities and socioeconomic services, including through social protection schemes such as the PSSN II. Majority of the beneficiaries of PSSN II are women and they benefit from conditional cash transfers, public works to livelihood support that include activities such as formulating saving groups, entrepreneurial skills training and provision of livelihood grant to finance their household enterprises.
